title: Faster, Smoother, Safer Rides! 🚀
subtitle: Here's what's new in this update:
highlights: 🚀 Much faster loading - driver home and rides screens now load instantly with direct database access
🐛 Fixed rider app crash after ride cancellation - app stays stable even when rides are cancelled
🛡️ Drivers must be near pickup location before starting trips - prevents false starts
🚫 Drivers with active rides can't accept new ones - focus on one ride at a time
💰 Fixed cashback rewards - used rewards won't show again in booking sheet
📍 Fixed driver date/time display - now shows correct dates for all rides
📱 Removed heavy caching - tabs load fresh data every time, no more stale content
🎨 Branded alert modals - consistent, beautiful error messages throughout the app
🔒 Automatic driver status - goes 'busy' during rides, 'online' when completed (if remittance is clear)
